description: LoS debug blocked lines are drawn solid only as far as the terrain that stops them, then ghosted to the target, so the actual blocker is readable instead of the board being buried under full-strength red. Custodian Guard is parked north of the area-large-14 / corner-ruin-left-20 dense stack with a Warboss south of it, so every sampled sight line is blocked. Holding L must produce per-model shooter lines that ALL carry a block_at point, and each point must lie ON its own segment and strictly before the target end (proving a real mid-line split, not a degenerate endpoint). Also covers the same split on the phase-independent L overview, and two bugs that killed the no-eligible-targets debug path outright: GameState.get_units() never existed (SCRIPT ERROR aborted refresh_los_debug_visuals) and the enemy-player derivation used 0/1 instead of this project's 1/2.

steps.comment: The hot-seat handoff screen is a full-screen CanvasLayer that eats input; acknowledge it the way the player's [Enter] does before driving anything.
Setup: park the Custodian Guard north of the dense terrain stack in the centre of the board and the Warboss south of it, so nothing can see anything.

Regression guard: GameState.get_units() is what refresh_los_debug_visuals calls when a shooter has no eligible target. It did not exist, so the whole path died on a SCRIPT ERROR and the overlay drew nothing.
Precondition, not the assertion: 'show all units' is a persisted user setting, so the real checkbox click below must start from a known OFF state or it would toggle the filter back ON.

A shooter with no eligible target is filtered out of the list by default, and the phase's SELECT_SHOOTER action refuses it outright — the roster row is the only path a player has to inspect WHY it cannot shoot. Turn the filter off with the real checkbox first.
Guard the hard-coded row index below against fixture drift, and scroll the row into view — the list is only 80px tall, and click_item_list refuses (correctly) to click a row that is scrolled off.
Nothing is shootable — this is exactly the case the LoS debug exists to explain.
Blocked shooter is the no-eligible-targets case, so the fan is drawn against every enemy unit. At least one line must exist at all.
Every line the overlay drew must know where it died — a line with no block_at falls back to the old flat full-strength draw.

Each block point must sit ON its own segment (perpendicular offset ~0) and strictly before the target end, so the drawn split is a real mid-line cut rather than a degenerate endpoint that would render as the old flat line.
And at least one split must leave a visible solid run before the blocker — otherwise every line would be ghosted end to end and the overlay would say nothing.
The phase-independent L overview splits its blocked unit->unit lines the same way: dashed red to the blocker, ghosted past it.
